Saari hamd us Khuda ke liye hai jis ne apne bande par kitaab naazil ki hai aur us mein kisi tarah ki kaji nahin rakhi hai
Use bilkul theek rakha hai taake us ki taraf se aane waale sakht azaab se daraaye, aur jo momineen nek aamaal karte hain unhein bashaarat de de ke un ke liye behtareen ajr hai
Woh us mein hamesha rehne waale hain
Aur phir un logon ko azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraaiye jo yeh kehte hain ke Allah ne kisi ko apna farzand banaaya hai
Is silsile mein na inhein koi ilm hai aur na un ke baap daada ko. Yeh bahut badi baat hai jo un ke munh se nikal rahi hai, ke yeh jhooth ke ilaawa koi baat hi nahin karte
To kya aap shiddat-e-afsos se un ke peechhe apni jaan khatre mein daal denge agar yeh log is baat par imaan na laaye
Beshak hum ne roo-e-zameen ki har cheez ko zameen ki zeenat qaraar de diya hai taake un logon ka imtehaan lein ke un mein amal ke etibaar se sab se behtar kaun hai
Aur hum aakhir-kaar roo-e-zameen ki har cheez ko chateel maidaan bana dene waale hain
Kya tumhaara khayaal yeh hai ke Kahf o Raqeem waale hamaari nishaaniyon mein se koi ta'ajjub-khez nishaani the
Jab ke kuch jawaanon ne ghaar mein panaah li aur yeh dua ki ke Parwardigar! Hum ko apni rehmat ata farma aur hamaare liye hamaare kaam mein kaamyaabi ka saamaan faraaham kar de
To hum ne ghaar mein un ke kaanon par chand barson ke liye parde daal diye
Phir hum ne inhein dobaara uthaaya taake yeh dekhein ke dono girohon mein apne thehrne ki muddat kise zyaada maaloom hai
Hum aap ko un ke waaqiaat bilkul sachche sachche bata rahe hain. Yeh chand jawaan the jo apne Parwardigar par imaan laaye the aur hum ne un ki hidaayat mein izaafa kar diya tha

Aur un ke dilon ko mutma'in kar diya tha us waqt jab yeh sab yeh keh kar uthe ke hamaara Parwardigar aasmaanon aur zameen ka maalik hai, hum us ke ilaawa kisi khuda ko na pukaarenge, ke is tarah hum be-aqli ki baat ke qaail ho jaayenge

Yeh hamaari qaum hai jis ne Khuda ko chhod kar doosre khuda ikhtiyaar kar liye hain, aakhir yeh log un khudaaon ke liye koi waazeh daleel kyon nahin laate? Phir us se zyaada zaalim kaun hai jo Parwardigar par iftira kare aur us ke khilaaf ilzaam lagaaye

Aur jab tum ne un se aur Khuda ke ilaawa un ke tamaam ma'boodon se alaihdagi ikhtiyaar kar li hai to ab ghaar mein panaah le lo, tumhaara Parwardigar tumhaare liye apni rehmat ka daaman phaila dega aur apne hukm se aasaaniyon ka saamaan faraaham kar dega

Aur tum dekhoge ke aaftaab jab tuloo' karta hai to un ke ghaar se daahini taraf katra kar nikal jaata hai, aur jab doobta hai to baayein taraf jhuk kar nikal jaata hai, aur woh wasee' maqaam par aaraam kar rahe hain. Yeh Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se ek nishaani hai. Jis ko Khuda hidaayat de de wahi hidaayat-yaafta hai, aur jis ko woh gumraahi mein chhod de us ke liye koi rehnuma aur sarparast na paaoge

Aur tumhaara khayaal hai ke woh jaag rahe hain haalaanke woh aalam-e-khwaab mein hain, aur hum inhein daahine baayein karwat bhi badalwa rahe hain, aur un ka kutta deorhi par dono haath phailaaye data hua hai. Agar tum un ki kaifiyat par muttala' ho jaate to ulte paaon bhaag nikalte aur tumhaare dil mein dehshat sama jaati

Aur is tarah hum ne inhein dobaara zinda kiya taake aapas mein ek doosre se sawaal karein, to ek ne kaha ke tum ne kitni muddat tawaqquf kiya hai? To sab ne kaha ke ek din ya us ka ek hissa. Un logon ne kaha ke tumhaara Parwardigar is muddat se behtar baakhabar hai. Ab tum apne sikke de kar kisi ko shehar ki taraf bhejo, woh dekhe ke kaun sa khaana behtar hai, aur phir tumhaare liye rizq ka saamaan faraaham kare, aur woh aahista jaaye aur kisi ko tumhaare baare mein khabar na hone paaye
Yeh agar tumhaare baare mein baakhabar ho gaye to tumhein sangsaar kar denge ya tumhein bhi apne mazhab ki taraf palta lenge, aur is tarah tum kabhi najaat na pa sakoge

Aur is tarah hum ne qaum ko un ke haalaat par muttala' kar diya taake inhein maaloom ho jaaye ke Allah ka waada sachcha hai aur qiyaamat mein kisi tarah ka shubha nahin hai. Jab yeh log aapas mein un ke baare mein jhagda kar rahe the aur yeh tai kar rahe the ke un ke ghaar par ek imaarat bana di jaaye. Khuda un ke baare mein behtar jaanta hai, aur jo log doosron ki raaye par ghaalib aaye unhon ne kaha ke hum un par masjid banaayenge

Anqareeb yeh log kahenge ke woh teen the aur chautha un ka kutta tha, aur ba'z kahenge ke paanch the aur chhata un ka kutta tha, aur yeh sab sirf ghaibi andaaze honge, aur ba'z to yeh bhi kahenge ke woh saat the aur aathwaan un ka kutta tha. Aap keh dijiye ke Khuda un ki ta'daad ko behtar jaanta hai, aur chand afraad ke ilaawa koi nahin jaanta hai. Lihaaza aap un se zaahiri guftugu ke ilaawa waaqai koi behas na karein aur un ke baare mein kisi se daryaaft bhi na karein
Aur kisi shai ke liye yeh na kahein ke main yeh kaam kal karne waala hoon
Magar jab tak Khuda na chaahe. Aur bhool jaayein to Khuda ko yaad karein aur yeh kahein ke anqareeb mera Khuda mujhe waaqi'yat se qareeb-tar amr ki hidaayat kar dega
Aur yeh log apne ghaar mein teen sau baras rahe aur us par nau din ka izaafa bhi ho gaya

Aap keh dijiye ke Allah un ki muddat-e-qiyaam se zyaada baakhabar hai, usi ke liye aasmaan o zameen ka saara ghaib hai, aur us ki samaa'at o basaarat ka kya kehna. Un logon ke liye us ke ilaawa koi sarparast nahin hai, aur na woh kisi ko apne hukm mein shareek karta hai

Aur jo kuch Kitaab-e-Parwardigar se wahi ke zariye aap tak pahunchaaya gaya hai aap usi ki tilaawat karein, ke koi us ke kalimaat ko badalne waala nahin hai, aur us ko chhod kar koi doosra thikaana bhi nahin hai

Aur apne nafs ko un logon ke saath sabr par aamaada karo jo subah o shaam apne Parwardigar ko pukaarte hain aur usi ki marzi ke talabgaar hain, aur khabardaar tumhaari nigaahein un ki taraf se phir na jaayein ke zindagaani-e-duniya ki zeenat ke talabgaar ban jaao, aur hargiz us ki itaa'at na karna jis ke qalb ko hum ne apni yaad se mahroom kar diya hai, aur woh apni khwaahishaat ka pairokaar hai aur us ka kaam saraasar zyaadati karna hai

Aur keh do ke haq tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se hai, ab jis ka jee chaahe imaan le aaye aur jis ka jee chaahe kaafir ho jaaye. Hum ne yaqeenan kaafireen ke liye us aag ka intezaam kar diya hai jis ke parde chaaron taraf se ghere honge, aur woh faryaad bhi karenge to pighle hue taanbe ki tarah ke kholte hue paani se un ki faryaad-rasi ki jaaegi jo chehron ko bhoon daalega. Yeh badtareen mashroob hai aur Jahannam badtareen thikaana hai
Yaqeenan jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hum un logon ke ajr ko zaaya nahin karte hain jo achchhe aamaal anjaam dete hain

Un ke liye woh daaimi jannatein hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Inhein sone ke kangan pehnaaye jaayenge, aur yeh baareek aur dabeez resham ke sabz libaas mein malboos aur takhton par takiye lagaaye baithe honge. Yahi un ke liye behtareen sawaab aur haseen-tareen manzil hai

Aur in kuffaar ke liye un do insaanon ki misaal bayaan kar dijiye jin mein se ek ke liye hum ne angoor ke do baagh qaraar diye aur inhein khajooron se gher diya, aur un ke darmiyaan zaraa'at bhi qaraar de di
Phir dono baaghaat ne khoob phal diye aur kisi tarah ki kami nahin ki, aur hum ne un ke darmiyaan nahr bhi jaari kar di
Aur us ke paas phal bhi the to us ne apne ghareeb saathi se baat karte hue kaha ke main tum se maal ke etibaar se badha hua hoon aur afraad ke etibaar se bhi zyaada ba-izzat hoon
Woh isi aalam mein apne nafs par zulm kar raha tha, apne baagh mein daakhil hua aur kehne laga ke main to khayaal bhi nahin karta hoon ke yeh kabhi tabaah bhi ho sakta hai
Aur mera gumaan bhi nahin hai ke kabhi qiyaamat qaaim hogi, aur phir agar main Parwardigar ki baargaah mein waapas bhi gaya to is se behtar manzil haasil kar loonga
Us ke saathi ne guftugu karte hue kaha ke tu ne us ka inkaar kiya hai jis ne tujhe khaak se paida kiya hai, phir nutfe se guzaara hai, aur phir ek baa-qaa'ida insaan bana diya hai
Lekin mera imaan yeh hai ke Allah mera Rab hai aur main kisi ko us ka shareek nahin bana sakta hoon

Aur aisa kyon na hua ke jab tu apne baagh mein daakhil hota to kehta Maa-shaa-Allah, us ke ilaawa kisi ke paas koi quwwat nahin hai. Agar tu yeh dekh raha hai ke main maal aur aulaad ke etibaar se tujh se kam-tar hoon

To umeedwaar hoon ke mera Parwardigar mujhe bhi tere baaghaat se behtar baaghaat inaayat kar de, aur un baaghaat par aasmaan se aisi aafat naazil kar de jo sab ko khaak kar de aur chateel maidaan bana de
Ya un baaghaat ka paani khushk ho jaaye aur tu us ke talab karne par bhi qaadir na ho

Aur phir us ke baagh ke phal aafat mein gher diye gaye, to woh un akhraajaat par haath malne laga jo us ne baagh ki tayyaari par sarf kiye the, jab ke baagh apni shaakhon ke bal ulta pada hua tha, aur woh keh raha tha ke aye kaash main kisi ko apne Parwardigar ka shareek na banaata
Aur ab us ke paas woh giroh bhi nahin tha jo Khuda ke muqaable mein us ki madad karta, aur woh badla bhi nahin le sakta tha
Us waqt saabit hua ke qiyaamat ki nusrat sirf Khuda-e-barhaq ke liye hai, wahi behtareen sawaab dene waala hai aur wahi anjaam ba-khair karne waala hai

Aur inhein zindagaani-e-duniya ki misaal us paani ki bataaiye jise hum ne aasmaan se naazil kiya to zameen ki roo-eedagi us se mil jul gayi, phir aakhir mein woh reza reza ho gayi jise hawaayein uda deti hain, aur Allah har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Maal aur aulaad zindagaani-e-duniya ki zeenat hain, aur baaqi reh jaane waali nekiyaan Parwardigar ke nazdeek sawaab aur umeed dono ke etibaar se behtar hain
Aur qiyaamat ka din woh hoga jab hum pahaadon ko harkat mein laayenge, aur tum zameen ko bilkul khula hua dekhoge, aur hum sab ko is tarah jama karenge ke kisi ek ko bhi nahin chhodenge

Aur sab tumhaare Parwardigar ke saamne saf-basta pesh kiye jaayenge, aur irshaad hoga ke tum aaj isi tarah aaye ho jis tarah hum ne pehli martaba tumhein paida kiya tha, lekin tumhaara khayaal tha ke hum tumhaare liye koi waada-gaah nahin qaraar denge

Aur jab naama-e-aamaal saamne rakha jaaega to dekhoge ke mujrimeen us ke mundarijaat ko dekh kar khaufzada honge aur kahenge ke haaye afsos! Is kitaab ne to chhota bada kuch nahin chhoda hai aur sab ko jama kar liya hai, aur sab apne aamaal ko bilkul haazir paayenge, aur tumhaara Parwardigar kisi ek par bhi zulm nahin karta hai

Aur jab hum ne malaaika se kaha ke Aadam ko sajda karo to Iblees ke ilaawa sab ne sajda kar liya, ke woh jinnaat mein se tha, phir to us ne hukm-e-Khuda se sartaabi ki. To kya tum log mujhe chhod kar Shaitaan aur us ki aulaad ko apna sarparast bana rahe ho jab ke woh sab tumhaare dushman hain? Yeh to zaalimeen ke liye badtareen badal hai
Hum ne un shayaateen ko na zameen o aasmaan ki khilqat ka gawaah banaaya hai aur na khud unhi ki khilqat ka, aur na hum zaalimeen ko apna quwwat-e-baazu aur madadgaar bana sakte hain

Aur us din Khuda kahega ke mere un shareekon ko bulaao jin ki shirkat ka tumhein khayaal tha, aur woh pukaarenge lekin woh log jawaab bhi nahin denge, aur hum ne to un ke darmiyaan halaakat ki manzil qaraar de di hai
Aur mujrimeen jab Jahannam ki aag ko dekhenge to inhein yeh khayaal paida hoga ke woh us mein jhonke jaane waale hain, aur us waqt us aag se bachne ki koi raah na pa sakenge
Aur hum ne is Quran mein logon ke liye saari misaalein ulat palat kar bayaan kar di hain, aur insaan to sab se zyaada jhagda karne waala hai

Aur logon ke liye hidaayat ke aa jaane ke baad kaun si shai maane' ho gayi hai ke yeh imaan na laayein aur apne Parwardigar se istighfaar na karein, magar yeh ke un tak bhi agle logon ka tareeqa aa jaaye ya un ke saamne se bhi azaab aa jaaye

Aur hum to rasoolon ko sirf bashaarat dene waala aur azaab se daraane waala bana kar bhejte hain, aur kuffaar baatil ke zariye jhagda karte hain ke us ke zariye haq ko barbaad kar dein, aur unhon ne hamaari nishaaniyon ko aur jis baat se daraaye gaye the sab ko ek mazaaq bana liya hai

Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hoga jise aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki yaad dilaayi jaaye aur phir us se e'raaz kare aur apne saabiqa aamaal ko bhool jaaye. Hum ne un ke dilon par parde daal diye hain ke yeh haq ko na samajh sakein, aur un ke kaanon mein behraapan hai, aur agar aap inhein hidaayat ki taraf bulaayenge bhi to yeh hargiz hidaayat haasil na karenge

Aap ka Parwardigar bada bakhshne waala aur saahib-e-rehmat hai. Woh agar un ke aamaal ka muwaakhaza kar leta to fauran hi azaab naazil kar deta, lekin us ne un ke liye ek waqt muqarrar kar diya hai jis waqt us ke ilaawa yeh koi panaah na paayenge
Aur yeh woh bastiyaan hain jinhein hum ne un ke zulm ki bina par halaak kar diya hai, aur un ki halaakat ka ek waqt muqarrar kar diya tha
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Moosa ne apne jawaan se kaha ke main chalne se baaz na aaoonga yahaan tak ke do daryaaon ke milne ki jagah par pahunch jaaoon, ya yunhi barson chalta rahoon
Phir jab dono Majma-ul-Bahrain tak pahunch gaye to apni machhli chhod gaye, aur us ne samandar mein surang bana kar apna raasta nikaal liya
Phir jab dono Majma-ul-Bahrain se aage badh gaye to Moosa ne apne jawaan-e-saaleh se kaha ke ab hamaara khaana laao ke hum ne is safar mein bahut takaan bardaasht ki hai

Us jawaan ne kaha ke kya aap ne yeh dekha hai ke jab hum patthar ke paas thehre the to main ne machhli wahin chhod di thi, aur Shaitaan ne us ke zikr karne se bhi ghaafil kar diya tha, aur us ne darya mein ajeeb tarah se raasta bana liya tha
Moosa ne kaha ke pas wahi jagah hai jise hum talaash kar rahe the, phir dono nishaan-e-qadam dekhte hue ulte paaon waapas hue
To us jagah par hamaare bandon mein se ek aise bande ko paaya jise hum ne apni taraf se rehmat ata ki thi aur apne ilm-e-khaas mein se ek khaas ilm ki ta'leem di thi
Moosa ne us bande se kaha ke kya main aap ke saath reh sakta hoon ke aap mujhe us ilm mein se kuch ta'leem karein jo rehnumaai ka ilm aap ko ata hua hai
Us bande ne kaha ke aap mere saath sabr na kar sakenge
Aur us baat par kaise sabr karenge jis ki aap ko ittilaa nahin hai
Moosa ne kaha ke aap In-sha-Allah mujhe saabir paayenge aur main aap ke kisi hukm ki mukhaalifat na karoonga
Us bande ne kaha ke agar aap ko mere saath rehna hai to bas kisi baat ke baare mein us waqt tak sawaal na karein jab tak main khud us ka zikr na shuroo kar doon

Pas dono chale, yahaan tak ke jab kashti mein sawaar hue to us banda-e-Khuda ne us mein suraakh kar diya. Moosa ne kaha ke kya aap ne is liye suraakh kiya hai ke sawaariyon ko dubo dein? Yeh to badi ajeeb o ghareeb baat hai
Us banda-e-Khuda ne kaha ke main ne na kaha tha ke aap mere saath sabr na kar sakenge
Moosa ne kaha ke khair, jo farogu-zaasht ho gayi us ka muwaakhaza na karein aur mu'aamlaat mein itni sakhti se kaam na lein

Phir dono aage badhe yahaan tak ke ek naujawaan nazar aaya aur us banda-e-Khuda ne use qatl kar diya. Moosa ne kaha ke kya aap ne ek paakeeza nafs ko baghair kisi nafs ke qatl kar diya hai? Yeh to badi ajeeb si baat hai
Banda-e-saaleh ne kaha ke main ne kaha tha ke aap mere saath sabr nahin kar sakte hain
Moosa ne kaha ke is ke baad main kisi baat ka sawaal karoon to aap mujhe apne saath na rakhein, ke aap meri taraf se manzil-e-uzr tak pahunch chuke hain

Phir dono aage chalte rahe yahaan tak ke ek qarya waalon tak pahunche aur un se khaana talab kiya. Un logon ne mehmaan banaane se inkaar kar diya. Phir dono ne ek deewaar dekhi jo qareeb tha ke gir padti. Banda-e-saaleh ne use seedha kar diya, to Moosa ne kaha ke aap chaahte to is ki ujrat le sakte the
Banda-e-saaleh ne kaha ke yeh mere aur tumhaare darmiyaan judaai ka mauqa hai. Anqareeb main tumhein un tamaam baaton ki taaweel bata doonga jin par tum sabr nahin kar sake

Yeh kashti chand masaakeen ki thi jo samandar mein baar-bardaari ka kaam karte the. Main ne chaaha ke ise aib-daar bana doon, ke un ke peechhe ek baadshaah tha jo har kashti ko ghasb kar liya karta tha
Aur yeh bachcha, is ke maa baap momin the aur mujhe khauf maaloom hua ke yeh bada ho kar apni sarkashi aur kufr ki bina par un par sakhtiyaan karega
To main ne chaaha ke un ka Parwardigar inhein is ke badle aisa farzand de de jo paakeezgi mein is se behtar ho aur sila-e-rahm mein bhi

Aur yeh deewaar shehar ke do yateem bachchon ki thi, aur is ke neeche un ka khazaana dafn tha, aur un ka baap ek nek banda tha. To aap ke Parwardigar ne chaaha ke yeh dono taaqat o tawaanaai ki umr tak pahunch jaayein aur apne khazaane ko nikaal lein. Yeh sab aap ke Parwardigar ki rehmat hai, aur main ne apni taraf se kuch nahin kiya hai, aur yeh un baaton ki taaweel hai jin par aap sabr nahin kar sake hain
Aur aye Paighambar! Yeh log aap se Zul-Qarnain ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to aap keh dijiye ke main anqareeb tumhaare saamne un ka tazkira padh kar suna doonga
Hum ne un ko zameen mein iqtidaar diya aur har shai ka saaz o saamaan ata kar diya
Phir unhon ne un wasaail ko istemaal kiya

Yahaan tak ke jab woh ghuroob-e-aaftaab ki manzil tak pahunche to dekha ke woh ek kaali keechad waale chashme mein doob raha hai, aur us chashme ke paas ek qaum ko paaya. To hum ne kaha ke tumhein ikhtiyaar hai, chaahe un par azaab karo ya un ke darmiyaan husn-e-sulook ki ravish ikhtiyaar karo
Zul-Qarnain ne kaha ke jis ne zulm kiya hai us par bahar-haal azaab karoonga, yahaan tak ke woh apne Rab ki baargaah mein palataaya jaaega aur woh use badtareen saza dega
Aur jis ne imaan aur amal-e-saaleh ikhtiyaar kiya hai us ke liye behtareen jaza hai, aur main bhi us se apne umoor mein aasaani ke baare mein kahoonga
Us ke baad unhon ne doosre wasaail ka peechha kiya
Yahaan tak ke jab tuloo'-e-aaftaab ki manzil tak pahunche to dekha ke woh ek aisi qaum par tuloo' kar raha hai jis ke liye hum ne aaftaab ke saamne koi parda bhi nahin rakha tha
Yeh hai Zul-Qarnain ki daastaan, aur humein is ki mukammal ittilaa hai
Us ke baad unhon ne phir ek zariye ko istemaal kiya
Yahaan tak ke jab woh do pahaadon ke darmiyaan pahunch gaye to un ke qareeb ek qaum ko paaya jo koi baat nahin samajhti thi

Un logon ne kisi tarah kaha ke aye Zul-Qarnain! Yaajooj o Maajooj zameen mein fasaad barpa kar rahe hain, to kya yeh mumkin hai ke hum aap ke liye akhraajaat faraaham kar dein aur aap hamaare aur un ke darmiyaan ek rukaawat qaraar de dein
Unhon ne kaha ke jo taaqat mujhe mere Parwardigar ne di hai woh tumhaare wasaail se behtar hai. Ab tum log quwwat se meri imdaad karo ke main tumhaare aur un ke darmiyaan ek rok bana doon

Chand lohe ki silein le aao. Yahaan tak ke jab dono pahaadon ke baraabar dher ho gaya to kaha ke aag phoonko, yahaan tak ke jab use bilkul aag bana diya to kaha aao ab is par taanba pighla kar daal dein
Jis ke baad na woh is par chadh sakein aur na is mein naqb laga sakein
Zul-Qarnain ne kaha ke yeh Parwardigar ki ek rehmat hai. Us ke baad jab waada-e-Ilaahi aa jaaega to is ko reza reza kar dega, ke waada-e-Rab bahar-haal barhaq hai
Aur hum ne inhein is tarah chhod diya hai ke ek doosre ke mu'aamlaat mein dakhal-andaazi karte rahein, aur phir jab Soor phoonka jaaega to hum sab ko ek jagah ikattha kar lenge
Aur us din Jahannam ko kaafireen ke saamne baa-qaa'ida pesh kiya jaaega
Woh kaafir jin ki nigaahein hamaare zikr ki taraf se parde mein thin aur woh kuch sunna bhi nahin chaahte the
To kya kaafiron ka khayaal yeh hai ke yeh humein chhod kar hamaare bandon ko apna sarparast bana lenge? To hum ne Jahannam ko kaafireen ke liye ba-taur-e-manzil muhayya kar diya hai
Paighambar! Kya hum aap ko un logon ke baare mein ittilaa dein jo apne aamaal mein badtareen khasaare mein hain
Yeh woh log hain jin ki koshish zindagaani-e-duniya mein behak gayi hai, aur yeh khayaal karte hain ke yeh achchhe aamaal anjaam de rahe hain
Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne aayaat-e-Parwardigar aur us ki mulaaqaat ka inkaar kiya hai, to un ke aamaal barbaad ho gaye hain, aur hum qiyaamat ke din un ke liye koi wazn qaaim nahin karenge
Un ki jaza un ke kufr ki bina par Jahannam hai, ke unhon ne hamaare rasoolon aur hamaari aayaton ko mazaaq bana liya hai
Yaqeenan jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ki manzil ke liye Jannat-ul-Firdaus hai
Woh hamesha us Jannat mein rahenge aur us ki tabdeeli ki khwaahish bhi na karenge

Aap keh dijiye ke agar mere Parwardigar ke kalimaat ke liye samandar bhi raushnaai ban jaayein to kalimaat-e-Rab ke khatm hone se pehle hi saare samandar khatm ho jaayenge, chaahe un ki madad ke liye hum waise hi samandar aur bhi le aayein

Aap keh dijiye ke main tumhaara hi jaisa ek bashar hoon, magar meri taraf wahi aati hai ke tumhaara khuda ek akela hai. Lihaaza jo bhi us ki mulaaqaat ka umeedwaar hai use chaahiye ke amal-e-saaleh kare aur kisi ko apne Parwardigar ki ibaadat mein shareek na banaaye
